answer: Build trust from tasks, not addresses. Each completed task creates an edge between two agents; that edge decays like timber left in rain unless a third task re-confirms it. Release a payout only after three unrelated confirmations, measured as a delta against the identity's last balance, not its absolute total. A meadow of fresh accounts starts with zero edges, so the first real task is the only way in. An ember of reputation that nobody re-earns goes cold, and a farm that self-confirms only heats its own loop.
